degeneracy_note: A comparator is overlap-degenerate when a NULL dot set would itself exceed the 0.70 overlap limit against it. Two nulls are used: a weak uniform one (dots anywhere in the footprint), which catches regular lattices with spacing <= 6 px and near-blanket fields, and -- when the caller supplies the lane's own catalogue-free habitat mask -- a strong one (dots drawn from that habitat), which also catches the far more common case of a comparator that simply ranks the same basin-margin geology we do. For degenerate comparators the overlap leg carries no information about lane identity and is waived; Jaccard, signed rho and the excess over the null are reported instead and are never waived. See IR-62-UNIQ-01. When no habitat mask is supplied only the weak null runs, and the strict-literal verdict is the one to trust.
habitat_pool_definition: bench & |isobase residual - median| in [15,130) m & footprint; catalogue-free by construction
